verdict.rationale: Undermind documents several first-party bulk capabilities. It can resolve titles, DOIs, or an entire bibliography into matching papers in bulk. It can read full-text PDFs in parallel and answer questions across many papers at once. Enterprise offers batch processing for high-volume research work. However, bulk management actions are not documented: starring and foldering appear only as per-item operations. Batch processing is a thin, enterprise-only claim, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/organize operations (bulk star, bulk folder moves, bulk delete), detailed docs on the batch-processing API and its limits, independent corroboration of bulk workflows

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
